lines.text: Paul says he is in no way inferior to the super-apostles, and signs, wonders, and miracles were performed among the Corinthians.
Paul is ready to come a third time and will not be a burden, because he seeks the Corinthians, not their possessions.
Paul says children should not save up for their parents, and he will gladly spend his money and himself for their souls.

wrong_details.wrong: children should not save up for their parents

lines.text: Paul urged Timothy to visit Corinth and sent a brother with him, and asks whether Timothy exploited them.
Paul fears quarreling, jealousy, and gossip, and that God will humble him before the Corinthians when he comes again.
